Habitat V0.2 (Build 32)

Changelog

  • Improved: Echo clipboard popup now shows image & video previews instead of file path.
  • Fixed: Addressed a couple background usage spikes and performance bugs.
  • Removed: Squeak mission control & App exposé trackpad toggle. Caused too many graphical issues.


    • Habitat V0.2 (Build 31)

    Changelog

  • Added: Leap tool guide.
  • Improved: Echo now has an option to pause the clipboard listener.
  • Improved: Burrow layout and file hierarchy structure. Now has a file preview option.
  • Improved: Echo’s drag and drop copied options.
  • Improved: Spark now has different icons for macs that don’t have an internal battery. And live energy graphs inside menubar icon should be more responsive when hovering over them.
  • Improved: Squeak spaces gestures now move windows smoothly across screen instead of an instant snap.
  • Improved: Leap navigation window no longer stays open waiting for an animation of a minimized app to appear.
  • Fixed: General performance bugs fixed across multiple tools. Should reduce system lags or stutters.
  • Fixed: Squeak drag to unsnap after a couple gestures.
  • Fixed: Habitat not working on boot until focused.


    • More to come.

    — Thank you for all the support & feedback!
